note: Adapted from the species description of Speculitermes paivai in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; neither the alate nor the soldier is recorded, only the worker; synonymy citations, figure references and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule golden brown, postclypeus slightly paler than head capsule; antennae, labrum, legs and thorax all pale yellow; abdominal tergites and sternites transparent, but the abdomen appears grey overall because the gut contents show through. Head very sparsely pilose, the rest of the body more densely pilose. Total body length 4.75-5.10 mm. Head subcircular, of the same size as the worker of deccanensis (length to mandible base 1.0-1.16 mm, maximum width 1.20-1.23 mm); mid-dorsal spot relatively large and distinctly raised, diameter 0.17 mm; V-shaped suture indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 relatively long, rod-shaped and subdivided. Postclypeus raised, with notches on both the anterior and posterior margins, less than half as long as wide (length 0.23-0.25 mm, width 0.53-0.57 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.40 mm, width 0.63-0.66 mm).
